 "data": "classDiagram\n\nclass AppShell\nclass BaseView {\n <<abstract>>\n +refresh() void\n}\nclass DonationController\nclass EventController\nclass VolunteerController\nclass BeneficiaryController\nclass PaymentController\n\nclass DonationService\nclass EventService\nclass VolunteerService\nclass BeneficiaryService\nclass PaymentService\n\nclass Donor {\n long id\n String name\n String email\n}\nclass Donation {\n <<abstract>>\n long id\n long donorId\n long amountCents\n}\nclass OnlineDonation\nclass CheckDonation\nclass InKindDonation\nclass DonationFactory {\n +create() Donation\n}\nclass Receipt {\n <<interface>>\n +render() String\n}\nclass BasicReceipt\nclass ReceiptDecorator {\n <<abstract>>\n}\nclass TaxReceiptDecorator\nclass ThankYouReceiptDecorator\n\nclass Event {\n int id\n String title\n LocalDate date\n}\nclass EventType\nclass EventRegistration\nclass Volunteer {\n int id\n String name\n}\nclass Skill\nclass VolunteerEventAssignment\n\nclass Beneficiary {\n long id\n String name\n int householdSize\n}\nclass NeedType\nclass Distribution\nclass DistributionPolicy {\n <<interface>>\n +allocate()\n}\nclass ByNeedDistributionPolicy\nclass EqualDistributionPolicy\nclass FifoDistributionPolicy\n\nclass Payment {\n long id\n long amountCents\n String status\n}\nclass PaymentGateway {\n <<interface>>\n +charge() GatewayResult\n}\nclass FakePaymentGatewayAdapter\nclass FakePaymentProvider\n\nclass Notifier\nclass NotificationStrategy {\n <<interface>>\n +send() void\n}\nclass EmailStrategy\nclass SmsStrategy\nclass SocialStrategy\nclass DonationSubject {\n <<interface>>\n}\nclass DonationObserver {\n <<interface>>\n +onDonationRecorded() void\n}\nclass ThankYouNotificationObserver\n\nclass DatabaseManager {\n <<singleton>>\n +getInstance() DatabaseManager\n}\n\nAppShell o-- BaseView\nAppShell --> DonationController\nAppShell --> EventController\nAppShell --> VolunteerController\nAppShell --> BeneficiaryController\nAppShell --> PaymentController\nDonationController --> DonationService\nEventController --> EventService\nVolunteerController --> VolunteerService\nBeneficiaryController --> BeneficiaryService\nPaymentController --> PaymentService\n\nDonor \"1\" --> \"0..*\" Donation : gives\nDonation <|-- OnlineDonation\nDonation <|-- CheckDonation\nDonation <|-- InKindDonation\nDonationService ..> DonationFactory : creates\nDonationService ..> Donation : records\nReceipt <|.. BasicReceipt\nReceipt <|.. ReceiptDecorator\nReceiptDecorator o-- Receipt : wraps\nReceiptDecorator <|-- TaxReceiptDecorator\nReceiptDecorator <|-- ThankYouReceiptDecorator\n\nEventType \"1\" --> \"0..*\" Event\nEvent \"1\" --> \"0..*\" EventRegistration\nEvent \"1\" --> \"0..*\" VolunteerEventAssignment\nVolunteer \"1\" --> \"0..*\" VolunteerEventAssignment\nSkill \"1\" --> \"0..*\" VolunteerEventAssignment\nVolunteer \"0..*\" -- \"0..*\" Skill : has\nEventService --> Event : manages\nVolunteerService --> Volunteer : manages\n\nBeneficiary \"1\" --> \"0..*\" Distribution\nNeedType \"1\" --> \"0..*\" Beneficiary\nBeneficiaryService --> Beneficiary : manages\nBeneficiaryService --> Distribution : records\nBeneficiaryService --> DistributionPolicy : uses\nDistributionPolicy <|.. ByNeedDistributionPolicy\nDistributionPolicy <|.. EqualDistributionPolicy\nDistributionPolicy <|.. FifoDistributionPolicy\n\nPaymentService ..> Payment : creates\nPaymentService --> PaymentGateway : uses\nPaymentGateway <|.. FakePaymentGatewayAdapter\nFakePaymentGatewayAdapter --> FakePaymentProvider\n\nNotifier --> NotificationStrategy : uses\nNotificationStrategy <|.. EmailStrategy\nNotificationStrategy <|.. SmsStrategy\nNotificationStrategy <|.. SocialStrategy\nDonationService ..|> DonationSubject\nDonationSubject --> DonationObserver : notifies\nDonationObserver <|.. ThankYouNotificationObserver\nThankYouNotificationObserver --> Notifier : sends message\n",
